verdict.stance: Neutral / High 18.9% CAR vs 5.8% NPL & Turkey Alternatif Bank Drag (A / A2 / A-)
verdict.summary: CBQ lifted CET1 to 12.8% and Total CAR to 18.9% in 9M26 despite Pillar Two taxes and Alternatif Bank (Turkey) IAS 29 drag pulling net profit to QAR 1.53bn. Elevated 5.8% NPLs (56.9% coverage) trail QNB, though Qatari sovereign support preserves A/A2/A- ratings.

positives: Total CAR strengthened 100bps YoY to 18.9% (CET1 12.8%) in 9M26.
High systemic importance in Qatar with strong sovereign support expectations (A / A2 / A-).
negatives: Elevated 5.8% NPL ratio with modest 56.9% Stage 3 coverage.
Turkish subsidiary (Alternatif Bank) hyperinflation losses and BEPS Pillar Two tax burden.

background.asset_perimeter: Qatar corporate/retail banking + Alternatif Bank (Turkey) + UAB/NBO associates.

catalysts.impact: Monitors NPL resolution and Alternatif Bank IAS 29 drag.

management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: Capital beat targets; NPLs remain sticky at 5.8%.

management_questions.question: Clarify path to lift Stage 3 coverage above 70% and Alternatif Bank strategic options.
management_questions.relevance: Key driver of spread relative to QNB/Doha peers.
